entries.source:
This is a trial version of Nimble Commander-Fork.
To continue using this software after the 30-day trial period, you have to either buy a license or install the paid version from Mac App Store.
This window appears only in the trial version.
entries.translation:
Is leagan trialach é seo de Nimble Commander-Fork.
Chun leanúint ar aghaidh ag baint úsáide as na bogearraí seo tar éis na tréimhse trialach 30-lá, caithfidh tú ceadúnas a cheannach nó an leagan íoctha a shuiteáil ó Mac App Store.
Ní fheictear an fhuinneog seo ach sa leagan trialach.
